title: Introduction to Correlation — Statistics
skills: define correlation in the context of data
identify positive, negative, and weak relationships between variables
interpret correlation patterns without assuming causation
apply basic statistical reasoning when evaluating evidence and research claims
alignment_note: Introduces correlation as a statistical relationship between variables and supports accurate interpretation of data patterns. Reinforces research literacy, evidence evaluation, quantitative reasoning, and careful analysis of claims across high school English and interdisciplinary research contexts.
